inputs.manifest: {"schema_version": "1.0.0", "id": "krea2/inpaint", "label": {"en": "Inpaint", "ru": "Inpaint"}, "family": "krea2", "family_label": "Krea 2 Turbo", "mode": "inpaint", "order": 30, "controls": [{"param": "prompt", "kind": "prompt", "superprompt": true}, {"param": "seed", "kind": "seed"}, {"param": "denoise", "kind": "slider", "min": 0.1, "max": 1.0, "step": 0.05, "label": {"en": "Repaint strength", "ru": "Сила перерисовки"}, "default": 1.0, "tooltip": {"en": "How much of the masked area is redrawn. 0.1-0.25 refines what is already there; 0.3-0.5 reworks it noticeably; 0.6-1.0 replaces the content.", "ru": "Насколько сильно перерисовывается область. 0.1–0.25 — уточнение того, что есть; 0.3–0.5 — заметная переработка; 0.6–1.0 — замена содержимого."}}, {"param": "loras", "kind": "loras", "max": 8, "strength": [-2.0, 2.0]}, {"param": "think_steps", "kind": "number", "advanced": true, "min": 1, "max": 12, "label": {"en": "Think steps (quality)", "ru": "Шаги размышления (качество)"}}, {"param": "steps", "kind": "number", "advanced": true, "min": 1, "max": 60, "label": {"en": "Steps", "ru": "Шаги"}}, {"param": "cfg", "kind": "number", "advanced": true, "min": 0, "max": 15, "step": 0.1, "label": {"en": "CFG", "ru": "CFG"}}], "refs": {"max": 0}, "requires": ["source_image", "mask"], "negative_prompt": false, "models": [{"title": "studio:model", "input": "unet_name", "folder": "diffusion_models", "match": "krea2.*turbo|Artius_Krea2"}, {"title": "studio:clip", "input": "clip_name", "folder": "text_encoders", "match": "qwen3vl_4b|Qwen3-VL-4B"}, {"title": "studio:vae", "input": "vae_name", "folder": "vae", "match": "qwen_image_vae"}], "dependencies": [{"pack": "LanPaint", "nodes": ["LanPaint_KSampler", "LanPaint_MaskBlend"]}]}
